# Tier-0 inventory per V3 SCOPED-DOWN (3 CLIs only)
TIER_0: dict[str, dict[str, str]] = {
    "codex": {
        "expected_z_path": "Z:/claude-sota-installed/.local/npm/codex.cmd",
        "fix_hint": (

        "fix_hint": (
            "C: drift → install Claude Code native at Z (see https://code.claude.com/docs/en/setup). "
            "Until native-Z install lands, eee.ps1 falls back to parent Z:/claude/.local/bin/claude.exe "
            "per (e1) native-install gate at tools/eee.ps1:212-218."
        ),
    },
}


def classify_scope(resolved: str | None) -> str:
    """Classify resolved path into Z (compliant) | C (CR-5/6 violation) | N (not in PATH) | ? (other)."""
    if not resolved:
        return "N"
    p = resolved.replace("\\", "/").lower()
    if p.startswith("z:/"):
        return "Z"
    if p.startswith("c:/"):
        return "C"
    return "?"


def cr5_6_status(scope: str) -> str:
    """Map scope to CR-5/6 conformance status."""
    if scope == "Z":
        return "PASS"
    if scope in ("C", "?"):
        return "FAIL"
    return "N/A"  # N (not in PATH at all)


def audit_cli(name: str) -> dict:
    """Resolve a CLI via shutil.which (TIER-1 stdlib) and produce a record dict."""
    resolved = shutil.which(name)
    scope = classify_scope(resolved)
    return {
        "ts": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "schema": "cli_path_audit.v1",
        "cli_name": name,
        "resolved_path": resolved if resolved else "(not in PATH)",
        "scope": scope,
        "cr5_6_status": cr5_6_status(scope),
        "expected_z_path": TIER_0[name]["expected_z_path"],
        "any_drift": scope != "Z",
    }


def emit_summary(records: list[dict]) -> None:
    """Print pretty per-CLI summary + actionable fix hints (V3 a6 actionability close)."""
    print("=== CLI PATH audit (Tier-0 codex+gh+claude per W154 F3 V3 SCOPED-DOWN) ===")
    print()
    pass_count = sum(1 for r in records if r["cr5_6_status"] == "PASS")
    fail_count = sum(1 for r in records if r["cr5_6_status"] == "FAIL")
    na_count = sum(1 for r in records if r["cr5_6_status"] == "N/A")
    print(f"Tier-0: {pass_count}/{len(records)} PASS / {fail_count} FAIL / {na_count} N/A")
    print()
    for r in records:
        marker = "PASS" if r["cr5_6_status"] == "PASS" else ("FAIL" if r["cr5_6_status"] == "FAIL" else "N/A ")
        print(f"  [{marker}] {r['cli_name']:8s} → {r['resolved_path']}")
        if r["any_drift"]:
            print(f"           FIX HINT: {TIER_0[r['cli_name']]['fix_hint']}")
            print()


def emit_json(records: list[dict]) -> None:
    """Print JSON array to stdout."""
    print(json.dumps(records, indent=2))


def emit_jsonl(records: list[dict]) -> None:
    """Append drift records ONLY to .claude/state/cli_path_audit.jsonl (V3 a3 capped schema)."""
    drift_records = [r for r in records if r["any_drift"]]
    if not drift_records:
        print("NO drift detected — JSONL not appended (capped per V3 a3 schema; "
              "every record would have any_drift=false).")
        return
    state_dir = _PROJECT_ROOT / ".claude" / "state"
    state_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    jsonl_path = state_dir / "cli_path_audit.jsonl"
    with jsonl_path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for r in drift_records:
            f.write(json.dumps(r) + "\n")
    print(f"Appended {len(drift_records)} drift record(s) to {jsonl_path}")


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Tier-0 CLI PATH conformance audit (W154 F3 V3 SCOPED-DOWN)"
    )
    parser.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", help="Print JSON array to stdout")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--jsonl",
        action="store_true",
        help="Append drift records ONLY to .claude/state/cli_path_audit.jsonl (capped)",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()

    records = [audit_cli(name) for name in TIER_0]

    if args.json:
        emit_json(records)
    elif args.jsonl:
        emit_jsonl(records)
    else:
        emit_summary(records)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
